purpose: Non-admission discovery of 14 mostly non-CAT Luxembourg building attribute/context sources and two European dwelling-calibration products; distinguish directly observable building geometry from aggregate statistics, uncertain rights and derived model evidence.

entries.name: Luxembourg 2025 solar potential roof and building shapefile
entries.temporal_scope: Solar modelling snapshot September 2025; original geometry and elevation upstream vintage to be checked
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Publisher has separate full Shapefile components: 58.8 MB SHP and 212.2 MB DBF plus SHX/PRJ/CPG, building-level 'hid' source identifier, polygon/multipolygon in EPSG:2169; WMS/documentation additionally describes distinct facet tilt, aspect, flat-roof and area3d layers
entries.note: High priority. Do not treat 'hid' as ACT 'buildingid' or EUBUCCO id: require spatial/versioned crosswalk. The SHP building layer is NOT proven to contain roof-facet 'tilt/aspect' attributes; these are described separately for the WMS roof-patch layer. The vendor's 2020 existing-panel detection is modelled and differs in year. Source includes street/house number: omit private address/person data from public artifacts. 2025 estimated solar POTENTIAL is not installed/insured PV. License catalogued 'Other (Open)', review exact legal terms, WMS access and share rights.

entries.name: Luxembourg STATEC RP2021 housing period-of-construction × building type
entries.spatial_scope: Luxembourg by census reporting geographic scope, including separate municipality housing tables
entries.temporal_scope: 2021 population and housing census; published/updated 2025 and 2026 catalogues
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Statistical dwelling (logement) counts classified by building type, period of construction, occupancy/tenure; national/municipal release tables differ, official DSD_CENSUS_NB_LOG_CLA@DF_B1706
entries.note: Critical gap: EUBUCCO Luxembourg has only 74 nonnull construction years among 186171 features. RP2021 classifies dwellings, NOT individual buildings; apartments in one building appear multiple times. NEVER assign a specific building construction year by disaggregating published age-band totals. Verify B1706 geographic dimensions vs B1707 municipality before any local calibration.

entries.name: Luxembourg STATEC authorised buildings and dwellings by type/region/canton
entries.spatial_scope: Luxembourg; reporting by region and canton, not individual parcels
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Multiple tables D411x of authorised buildings, permitted dwellings and approved useful area by building type and reporting geography
entries.note: Building permissions are planned, not completed, occupied or guaranteed erected buildings, and cannot identify a specific ACT2023v2 polygon. Compare same geography, building-vs-dwelling unit and annual vintage with completion statistics. Dataset is statistics, not a building permit geolocation registry.

entries.name: Luxembourg STATEC completed building counts and average new residential areas
entries.spatial_scope: Luxembourg national and table-dependent geographic detail
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Official 'Les bâtiments achevés par genre de bâtiment' DF_D4200 and 'Surface moyenne ... bâtiments résidentiels achevés' DF_D4202
entries.note: Counts of completed building units, not identified exact buildings; average apartment unit living area is not individual footprint area or total floor area. Can cross-check permits-to-completion pipeline with time lags and national building totals without claiming direct geographic matching.

entries.name: Luxembourg national protected monuments official INSPIRE GML and OGC services
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 6.4MB INSPIRE GML National Monuments and protected/inventory listed sites; object identifiers/descriptions and geometries, may contain historic buildings or cadastral zones
entries.note: Provider labels CC0. Protected sites may be a parcel, object, site or entire historic complex, NOT always a single building, and designation does not prove building year or wall material. Screen GML geometry semantics, preserve original site ID/status/year, do not classify all unlisted buildings as nonhistoric or assume replacement costs.

entries.name: Luxembourg public building inventory under EU Energy Efficiency Directive article 6
entries.provider: Luxembourg Ministry of the Economy / Klima-Agence
entries.spatial_scope: Luxembourg public-sector heated or cooled properties with energy reference area >250 m2
entries.temporal_scope: Initial partial inventory reported during 2025, published May 20 2026, planned annual updates
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Inventaire.xlsx one row per public building, energy reference area, annual metered energy if available, EPC PDF cross references; hundreds of original individual certificates linked
entries.note: Published inventory expressly initial/incomplete and only heated/cooled public bodies >250m2. Downloading a publicly posted EPC PDF is NOT bulk reuse approval. Do not copy address, operator, contact/person details or 826 PDFs into Git/Neon; audit workbook licence and source records separately. Floor 'energy reference area' is not ground footprint nor insured reinstatement cost.

entries.name: Luxembourg 1967 countrywide official historic 50cm orthophoto
entries.provider: Administration du Cadastre et de la Topographie (ACT)
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 0.5m monochrome JP2 orthophoto, EPSG:2169, approx 12.3GB complete country file; historic roof/settlement presence possible
entries.note: The national dataset portal explicitly states 'License Not Specified'. DO NOT ingest/redistribute raw images without provider rights review. A visible roof in 1967 gives building-presence constraint, not precise construction year; absence can reflect shadows/georeferencing/interpretation or demolition/rebuild. Per-tile access required, not 12.3GB direct load.

entries.name: Luxembourg 2001 official orthophoto archived by municipality
entries.provider: Administration du Cadastre et de la Topographie (ACT)
entries.spatial_scope: Luxembourg nationwide, divided into regional JP2 assets
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 0.5m, 1m, 10m JP2 historic building/roof imagery incl municipality-level tiles; national JP2 2.6GB
entries.note: Official CC0 catalogue. Read municipality tiles rather than national asset, and account for imagery interpretation limits. A building existing in 2001 may have been renovated/rebuilt since; historical observation != construction year or structural materials. Map with ACT2023v2 and 2025 aerial dates, never use as independent cadastre ground-truth.

entries.name: Luxembourg summer 2025 aerial RGB/CIR building roof imagery
entries.provider: Administration du Cadastre et de la Topographie (ACT)
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 10cm RGB, CIR and RGBI orthophotos in EPSG:2169, JP2 national assets 64GB/68GB/136GB plus per-tile products and WMS
entries.note: Actual 2025 10cm aerial photos are not guaranteed actual current installed PV occupancy; image classification detects appearances with false positives and shadows. Preserve acquisition timestamp; roof material/pitch cannot be fully identified with imagery alone. DO NOT download nation-scale assets into Git or metadata DB.

entries.name: Luxembourg national towns, streets and official house-number reference CACLR
entries.provider: Administration du Cadastre et de la Topographie (ACT)
entries.spatial_scope: Luxembourg national addresses and postal geography, no geometry
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Official house numbers, street/locality and postcode, machine-readable ZIP of text files approx 1.9 MB and optional 41.1MB XLSX
entries.note: Registry explicitly has NO geographic coordinates and completeness not guaranteed. Street/house number is an address identifier, not unique building/polygon; one address may contain numerous residential units. REST API requires CTIE gateway access request; bulk public ZIP exists. Avoid publishing household-level linked addresses or reverse geolocating personal exposure.

entries.name: Luxembourg ministry anonymised residential EPC aggregates on application
entries.provider: Luxembourg Ministry of the Economy / Energy Efficiency
entries.spatial_scope: Luxembourg residential buildings; currently national aggregate request only
entries.resolution_or_granularity: On-request nationwide aggregated anonymised residential building EPC statistics; online application form required, no individual building dataset
entries.note: Government explicitly provides ANONYMISED NATIONAL AGGREGATES ON REQUEST, currently residential only. Cannot scrape private building-energy passports, infer individual building ages from aggregates, or claim immediate public machine downloads. A formal data request would require the user's own action/authorisation.

entries.name: Eurostat Census 2021 occupied dwellings by construction period and NUTS3
entries.spatial_scope: EU 2021 census countries and reporting NUTS3 regions
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Official table cens_21dwop_r3: conventional dwellings by occupancy status, construction period and NUTS3, obtainable via Eurostat dissemination/API
entries.note: DWELLING counts, not building counts. A multi-unit building contributes many dwellings. Statistical suppression, country coverage, age bands and NUTS3 vintage must be retained; never assign construction year to individual building or treat model downscaling as ground truth.

entries.name: JRC-ESTAT Census Dwelling Grid 2021 1 km raster
entries.spatial_scope: EU27 plus participating neighbouring European countries by asset scope
entries.resolution_or_granularity: GeoTIFF 1km gridded estimated conventional dwellings, redistributed from official LAU 2021 counts using residential built-up volume proxy
entries.note: IMPORTANT: JRC states ancillary layers include EUBUCCO v0.1, DBSM R2023, Overture, GHS-BUILT and other shared source families: NOT independent validation of EUBUCCO/DBSM building footprints. It is a modelled grid constrained to municipal dwelling totals, NOT surveyed exact building geometry/occupancy. Access listing says no login despite site showing 'Log in'; test actual file retrieval before ingest.

entries.name: Luxembourg municipal renovation and renewable-energy incentive policy inventory
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 244kB official municipality funding policy Excel table (eligibility categories for insulation, heating, renewables, transport)
entries.note: This describes AVAILABLE GRANTS, not actual executed building renovations, nor roof/wall changes by building, nor receipt of subsidies. Cannot use as observed mitigation or building age. The catalogue licence is 'Other (Open)' requiring legal check.
